text:
Midday here and it's a gorgeous one, clear and already 63, just shy of the high near 64. Clouds may build a bit this afternoon, but I'd count on a dry stretch, so this is the day to get the walk or the ride in. The sun sets around 4:35, so don't wait too long. Tonight stays mostly cloudy and mild, with a low around 45. A sprinkle is possible after 5am, but the real rain holds off until Saturday.

Saturday is the wet one. The morning looks mostly dry, then rain fills in around 2pm and gets steadier into the evening. It's cooler, with a high near 54. The afternoon itself is fairly light, but the bulk comes Saturday night, a quarter to half inch with the low dropping to around 37. The forecasters say the heavier rain has trended toward us, so I'd lean toward the wetter end of that range. Bring the rain jacket, and expect gusts up to 25 mph in the afternoon.

Sunday starts with lingering rain, then tapers off by about 1pm, with maybe a stray shower until 3. It stays mostly cloudy and cold. NWS says a high near 52, but the American and Canadian-style guidance runs cooler, so I'd bet on the upper 40s. A few wet flakes could mix in on the higher hills overnight, but not here in town. Sunday night brings a chance of showers, with the low near 37.
